theorem: For the exact six-variable Householder physical matrix with nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}, any fixed nonzero finite remote fragment cell of bank center R d has global output-density cap 4 sqrt(6)/(R ||d||) once R||d||>=3sqrt(2), even when d is an exact irrational null vector. Fixed finite unit-height interval fragmentations therefore satisfy ||p_R||inf <= ||p_*||inf + C_F/R. Their positive one-sheet side satisfies sup_{s>=0} p_R(s) <= p_*(0)+C_F/R, hence is <3sqrt(2) for large R.
